notes.subject: mɔgɔ
notes.rationale: Hebrew מהקיץ has no explicit subject ('one who awakens'); Bambara needs a subject, supplied and bracketed

notes.subject: cogo-ɲɔgɔn
notes.rationale: צלם here is 'phantom/illusion' — the insubstantial form of the wicked; rendered as 'likeness/form', the 'phantom' picture is thinned

notes.subject: בעיר
notes.rationale: 'when you awake' vs 'when you arise (to judge)'; the waking belongs to Adonay, completing the dream metaphor — the wicked vanish like a dream when the sleeper wakes

translation: I n'a fɔ sukwɛlɛ ye — ni ⟨mɔgɔ⟩ tu — Adonay, ni i tu, i bɛ u cogo-ɲɔgɔn dɔgɔya.
